name: State Pride
text: When creating a MERCENARIES warband, you must select two of the following rules to represent your warband's home province:

options.name: Huntsmen
options.text: Increase the Shoot characteristic of all Marksmen by 1.

options.name: Hardy
options.text: Increase the Health characteristic of all Warriors and Champions by 2.

options.name: State Troopers
options.text: Increase the Fight characteristic of all Warriors by 1.

options.name: Unyielding
options.text: Increase the Bravery characteristic of all fighters by 1.

options.name: Desperate
options.text: You cannot recruit Warriors or Marksmen, but may recruit Youngbloods for 50% of their recruitment fee.

options.name: Well Drilled
options.text: At the end of each Aftermath Sequence, select one Henchman to earn 1 Renown.

options.name: Wealthy Patrons
options.text: Gain an additional 30gc when collecting income in the aftermath sequence.

options.name: Deeply Religious
options.text: Roll 7 initiative dice in each initiative phase instead of 6.

name: Well-connected
text: MERCENARIES warbands maintain vast networks of contacts. When setting up a battle, a MERCENARIES warband may recruit one Hired Sword for half its normal hiring fee.
